notes.title: Update Custom
notes.notes:
We continue to try to upgrade programs, such as program descriptions.

The first is continuous custom menu expansion.
Next to the character, a cute pet is added to fill the screen, and BGM is added to enrich the video.
BGM may be a menu that anyone who edits may not need, but the purpose we seek is a tool for creators who don't even use editing tools.

And a little bit of convenience has been improved. I feel uncomfortable using the program and lack of the guide and will continue to try to improve.

This is not the end of our program. It will continue to be upgraded, and users who purchase will continue to benefit.
